law_record.title: Certain vehicles required to stop at all railroad grade (7)(a)
law_record.text: It is unlawful for the driver of any vehicle: When crossing at grade any track or tracks of a railroad, to fail to completely cross the track or tracks without stopping due to insufficient: (1) Space for the vehicle on the opposite side of the railroad crossing; or (2) Undercarriage clearance of the vehicle. As used in this section, “completely cross” means to travel across a railroad track or tracks in such a manner that the trailing end of the vehicle is 15 feet or more past the nearest rail of the railroad track or tracks.

activation_conditions: the subject crosses a railroad track at grade
it stops before its trailing end is 15 feet past the nearest rail
the stop is due to insufficient space on the far side or insufficient undercarriage clearance
residue: undercarriage clearance is a property of the vehicle, not of the scene: at best inferred from class and the crossing's profile
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the rule is about an episode: entry onto the crossing, the stop, and whether the 15-foot clearance was reached
the insufficiency must precede the entry for the failure to be the one the rule names
a momentary hesitation is separated from a stop by the drv.stopped parameters
